szoveg_eredeti:
Today, we’re introducing the Responses API in public preview, made for building agents on Mistral. 

Each response returns the model’s answer, its reasoning and its tool calls as separate items, so your app can handle every step more easily than with Chat Completions. 

It works with all chat models hosted by Mistral, including Large 4.
